answer: Require every agent to post a small non-refundable stake before joining a voyage of paid work, and stamp it on the agent like a pigment mark that cannot be washed off. A sybil operator spawning a thousand clones must pay a thousand stakes, while honest agents earn theirs back through verified output. Each completed job leaves an echo in a public record, so verifiers only trust agents whose history shows real cost and real work, and cheap copies stay silent and untrusted.
